description: Adversarial scenario suite for simulation round 2 testing estimator resilience against behavioural distortions, selection bias, and heterogeneous effects.

rows.description: Attacks null accuracy using differential arm skipping combined with general and frustration-induced dropout.
Attacks recall estimates via MNAR skipping when expected failure is high alongside baseline arm omission (research digest section 1).
Attacks null validity through undeclared outside study in the baseline arm producing an unmodeled boost.
Verifies that declared outside study in the baseline arm is properly excluded without inflating null error rates.
Attacks retention estimates by compounding consecutive failure frustration hazard with baseline skipping.
Attacks delayed recall inference when a short-term variant advantage decays rapidly via shorter half-life (research digest section 6).
Attacks detection of large true treatment effects through undeclared baseline contamination that shrinks observed gaps.
Attacks population-level conclusions when 30 percent of learners experience a sign reversal in method efficacy (research digest section 3).
Control for step 2b: preference has zero causal effect and current product does not read preference (research digest section 1).
Attacks stability of method estimates when an initial novelty boost decays exponentially across completed units.
Attacks evaluation accuracy via answer key grading errors rejecting valid correct variant responses.
Attacks arm comparability through systematic difficulty imbalances assigned to variant units.
Attacks protocol window validity with delayed responses answered after the day 7-14 evaluation boundary.
Attacks static treatment assumptions via expertise reversal where early advantages decay and flip with practice (research digest section 3).
